correctness.rationale: Exact bijection between ternary order-three necklaces and nine S_3 local permutations with a single 27-cycle successor. Lexicographic triple uniqueness gives nine BWT permutation blocks and exact r,c boundary formulas. Exhaustive 6^9 loop plus distinct Euler-tour enumeration each produce the complete 18-cell table, count 373248, and sharp minima 19 and 18. Both supplied C++17 programs were compiled, executed from actual package source paths, and passed all hard assertions.

value.rationale: The BWT run count is a natural cost parameter for run-length compressed BWT and run-based indexing. This is the complete exact cost profile for all 373248 ternary order-three universal cycles, not an arbitrary sample or single outlier; the joint table distinguishes ordinary versus wraparound runs, determines all realizable pairs and exact numbers of best cycles (74 versus 16), and provides a meaningful benchmark for comparing full-alphabet universal sequences. No general-order theorem or unsupported application-performance claim is made.
